summary: Python builder for Quick Dev TDD invocation artifacts; validates plan under execution-plans and loads contract/registry/slice; supports generated RED for quick-dev owner with strict test selector, failure IDs, allowed-test checks, or legacy/prior RED with hashed predecessor validation; expands plan/repo/run placeholders and enforces root cwd, non-shell commands; loads isolated plan-local validator identity; computes execution fingerprint from slice semantics, commands, validator and test hash; builds run-context with authority/contract payloads, requirements, acceptance, boundaries, targets and stage results; writes run-context, RED, GREEN, refactor, preparation and terminal command JSON into a new output directory; errors on invalid schema, paths, hashes, commands, identities or missing test; CLI requires repository-root, plan-dir, slice-id, run-id, out-dir.
